title: Ambiguous side-effect retry
description: A write may commit before its response times out; retrying without stable identity may duplicate the side effect.

metadata.purpose: Test whether a retried write preserves operation identity, idempotency evidence, and a single observed side effect.

requirements.description: Call the synthetic write tool for the requested order action.
Observe a successful response after the ambiguous timeout.
Observe authorization before the protected write.
Reuse one operation identifier across the timeout and retry.
Reuse one idempotency key across the timeout and retry.
Observe one side-effect identifier rather than a duplicate write.
